notes:
- Fixed: the first rep of a set could read too high after a slow descent.
- Fixed: touch-and-go reps could be merged into one, and settling or re-racking the bar could count as a rep.
- Mean velocity now ends at the lockout. Final rep values are steadier and can arrive a little later.
- Calibration no longer rescales the accelerometer. Readings can differ from the previous version by a few per cent, depending on the sensor (higher on the sensors tested so far).
- New for app developers: the sensor reports its Bluetooth protocol version (1.0).
- Use companion app 1.0.9 or later. Updating from the app requires the OTAFIX bootloader: https://github.com/ODKI-tech/ODKI-VBT/blob/main/Hardware/Instructions/BOOTLOADER.md
- Known limitation: live velocity and position can be off at the start of some sets.
